events.subtitle: 40th Anniversary Live Tour 2026
events.factual_description: COTTON CLUB presents Carlos Toshiki's 40th Anniversary Live Tour 2026 on November 18-19, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The venue traces the anniversary to Toshiki's 1986 debut as vocalist of the second Omega Tribe lineup, later renamed Carlos Toshiki & Omega Tribe, and highlights songs including Kimi wa 1000%, Super Chance and Aquamarine no Mama de Ite. The announced band includes bassist Wornell Jones and saxophonist/percussionist Teruo Goto, described by the presenter as longtime musical allies, plus Tomoharu Hani, Fumio 'HANK' Nishiyama and Marty Bracey. COTTON CLUB describes the room as a Tokyo home base for Toshiki.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to keep this on RADAR is not simply nostalgia for a city-pop name. Toshiki's Japanese-Brazilian biography sits inside one of the strands that made late-1980s Omega Tribe feel culturally specific, and the 40th-anniversary framing brings that repertoire back with longtime collaborators in a room the presenter itself describes as his Tokyo home base. It is a compact way to hear a piece of Japanese pop history as a living band rather than as retro iconography.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one of the four sets if your Tokyo dates overlap, especially if the Japan trip has a city-pop or postwar-pop-history thread. It is a strong evening to build around in Tokyo, but I would not reorganize the larger itinerary solely for this engagement.
